title: SREV-049 COM ClosedRT multi-string contract

setting.description: Configuration setting name, for example ClosedRT

entry.description: One optional image-filtered runtime class identifier

multi_string.description: NUL-separated list terminated by an empty final string

contracts: Com_LoadRTList owns the cached ClosedRT runtime-class list
The cached list is a WCHAR multi-string with an empty final string
The first WCHAR is initialized to NUL before the second configuration pass
The second pass must not copy an entry unless it leaves room for the final empty string
A configuration drift between the count pass and copy pass produces a shorter valid list, not uninitialized data or overflow
RoGetActivationFactory receives an HSTRING activatableClassId and WindowsGetStringRawBuffer is the local string-inspection boundary
